I'm sorry, but we can't do that. Once an order has shipped, the shipping address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy, so we're not able to ask them to redirect it.

Shipped orders also can't be cancelled. If the package can't be delivered or doesn't arrive, tell us. If tracking hasn't moved for 4 business days, or it shows delivered but nothing turned up, we'll open a courier investigation (up to 5 business days). If the package is confirmed lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.
